biotools.summary: This tool identifies long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) involved in the shade avoidance syndrome in Arabidopsis thaliana, using RNA-seq data and a guilt-by-association approach to infer functions and identify potential candidates. The tool also provides access to T-DNA Express for gene mapping and expression analysis.
